display_name: 源物理后验教师的 DURA 修正 GPU 训练
description: 冻结 DURA，独立初始化多尺度修正，用合法源 IQ 和以源 clean 理想步长生成的物理后验教师训练；目标推理不使用教师、clean、理想步长或协方差求解。

data.representation: paired received/clean IQ, per-packet DURA and its estimated physical action

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0, independently initialized zero-head multiscale correction; fixed source-only posterior teacher targets loaded only during training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source provenance; posterior teacher completed fixed commit 934112e2bfaea29f0437e8853c203c0dd25c8c37 with zero F/TX/V/target access; 8192 ordered fit IDs and three epoch views match
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and posterior teacher are source-only, no F/TX labels or target ancestry; teacher clean-derived optimal step is training-only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5, no source or target performance selection

rows.method: Fresh DURA multiscale correction trained with source IQ and DURA guard plus 0.5 normalized source posterior-teacher IQ loss
rows.purpose: Train a distinct F-free recovery network at fixed five-epoch budget
rows.seed_notes: Fresh correction init 2026110612, source fit 2026110611, batch order 2026110613, DURA seed 2026092701; no target selection.

notes: Teacher generated using matching source clean IQ and the source-covariance posterior with DURA estimated action/noise, 160 CG steps, source-only positive ideal step [0,.5].
Teacher targets and ideal step are privileged source training information and are never read during ground inference.
The fresh network trains on original source IQ and DURA guard plus teacher waveform loss weight 0.5; no F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target IQ/truth.
Use deterministic training and exact-fit source context cache; fixed five epochs and full seven-view Phase1 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL test regardless of source diagnostics.
Teacher generation took 365.3 seconds, plus prior/cached context and original DURA preparation costs; all costs are reported separately.
Source teacher improvements do not establish identity accuracy or target performance; no target feedback into training or test selection.
